title: The OER Evaluator Loop
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Open Educational Resources
description: A closed loop with eight numbered stations that shows how the chapters fit together, and why test results are used to calibrate the AI agent.

educational.topic: The whole book as one closed loop of evaluation, improvement, testing, and publishing
learningObjectives: The learner will describe the eight stations of the OER Evaluator loop in order and explain why test results are used to calibrate the AI agent.
prerequisites: None. This poster is the overview, so it works before or after any chapter.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore a reference picture, then quiz on the same picture
keyQuestions: Where am I on the loop?
What evidence lets me trust an automated score?
commonMisconceptions: An AI agent can replace the human review
The loop ends when a resource is published
assessmentOpportunities: Which station comes right after "check the agent"?
What does the return arrow from station 7 to station 3 mean?
Which chapters teach scoring by hand?

controls.name: Explore and Quiz buttons
controls.description: switch between exploring the poster and answering quiz questions.

controls.name: Numbered markers
controls.description: hover or press to read about that part of the poster. In quiz mode a press is your answer.

controls.name: Try Again
controls.description: repeats the quiz after the last question.
